case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our cooperation and the quality your foundry delivers just as much.

At the same time, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have put together options that reflect the cost development fairly:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

All options offer a longer contract term for more planning security on your side. Option C also keeps your current payment terms unchanged.

We look forward to your feedback.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term partnerships are the foundation of our foundry's success. You mention cost developments, but we kindly ask you to share the specific data you are referring to, as our own verified costs remain high. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

In recognition of the extended contract term, we are prepared to offer a price of €51.30 per unit while maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms. For your review, this Angebot includes a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for welcoming the longer contract term.

We understand that labour and steel weigh on your costs, and we take that seriously. Your movement is appreciated. However, we still see the gap as too wide. We have updated our options in a genuine step towards you:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 47.36; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.98; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.05; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Option C keeps your standard payment terms, as you asked, and all options give you the security of the longer contract. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your genuine step towards us and your understanding of the pressure from labour and steel costs. To bridge the gap further, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.50 per unit. This offer maintains the 24-month contract and 30-day payment terms that provide stability for both our houses. 

For our current Angebot, we are pleased to state a price of €50.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days. It is always a pleasure to work together with partners who value our traditional craftsmanship and long-standing connection.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
